question: Can an observation-matched empirical distribution of intact train residual cubes reproduce validation density fields when a learned factorized likelihood cannot?

selected_control.name: source_balanced_observation_matched_full_cube_latent_knn
selected_control.unit_resampled: one complete exact-zero-DC V21 G21 latent cube, never voxels, Fourier modes, Haar scales, or marginal values independently
selected_control.donors: all 432 TNG100, 202 SIMBA, and 409 Swift train cubes only
selected_control.query_information: target-free preprocessed count, line-of-sight velocity, corrected deterministic mean, radius-invariant observable global features, and no validation density truth
selected_control.orientation: best of the same 48 observer-centred signed cube isometries, applied identically to donor condition and donor latent
selected_control.interpretation: a diagnostic conditional empirical control rather than a claim that the selected donor phases are uniquely observed

rejected_controls.unconditional_train_cube_resampling: preserves the joint field but does not test whether observables select the correct environment
rejected_controls.per_scale_or_per_band_resampling: breaks the cross-scale dependence whose failure is under test
rejected_controls.voxelwise_empirical_cdf_sampling: preserves marginals but destroys filaments, peaks, voids, and two-point structure
rejected_controls.same_domain_only_donors: uses a simulation-family label unavailable for CF4 and can overstate transfer
rejected_controls.another_learned_flow_or_diffusion_varian: does not provide the requested decisive nonparametric control after V26 and V27
